Table 5. Working List of Visual Meteor Showers. Details in this Table were correct
according to the best information available in June 2025, wit h maximum dates accurate only
for 2026. The parenthesized maximum date for the Puppids-Ve lids indicates a reference date for
the radiant only, not necessarily a true maximum. The given Z HR is based on recent observed
returns. Possibly periodic showers are noted as ‘Var’ = vari able. For more information check
the updates published e.g. in the IMO Journal WGN.
